mapper.update: UPDATE `document` SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, current_version = #{currentVersion}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, document_code, tenant_id, owner_user_id, source_file_id, title, document_type, status, current_version, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, document_code, tenant_id, owner_user_id, source_file_id, title, document_type, status, current_version, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE document_code = #{documentCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, document_code, tenant_id, owner_user_id, source_file_id, title, document_type, status, current_version, created_at, updated_at FROM `document` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
